US-listed software (NOW, WDAY) face structural headwinds from AI-driven cost compression and enterprise budget scrutiny, making them structurally weaker for Indonesia-focused portfolios.

Favor hardware/telecom over software; trim any US-linked positions (NOW, AMZN) into strength. Re-enter on ID index stabilization above -0.5% daily.

sectors.ai: Buy selective small-cap FMCG names riding the IDX momentum wave, but lock gains fast—this is a liquidity-driven squeeze, not fundamentals. Rotate into BEER and AMMS for beer/glass exposure with volume confirmation; avoid chasing SSTM/BIKE at +25% without earnings proof. Trim into strength by Friday, keep core in staples with US-linked demand.

Expect continued outperformance over 1-2 quarters; add on dips toward the 50-day moving average.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesia's pending crypto tax harmonization and Bappebti licensing reforms will structurally favor compliant, yield-generating tokens over meme coins, driving sustained institutional inflows.

Privacy and utility coins (XMR, RAIN) are gaining share as regulatory overhang on centralized exchanges pushes capital toward decentralized, auditable networks with real usage.
sectors.ai: Buy selective liquid crypto names (FIGR_HELOC, RAIN, XMR) on this dip; the aggregate -2.93% masks idiosyncratic strength in yield-bearing and privacy tokens, signaling rotation not exit. Indonesia's regulatory clarity on digital asset taxation and exchange licensing is a tailwind for compliant platforms. Trim TRUMP and TRX into strength; their beta to sentiment is fading.
